verdict.rationale: Auth0 documents the OAuth 2.0 Device Authorization Flow explicitly for input-constrained devices/CLIs (docs-9, docs-26, docs-40), and its own MCP Server product uses this exact flow to let AI tools like Claude Desktop authenticate against a tenant without pasting long-lived secrets (docs-13, docs-41, auth0-gh-1). This is a first-party, standards-based implementation directly matching the CLI/headless-agent use case in the story.  missing for 10: independent/hands-on third-party verification of the device flow specifically in CLI/agent contexts beyond Auth0's own docs and MCP server example.
